verdict.rationale: Poke documents an API for sending messages, a CLI login, and an X-Poke-User-Id header on MCP requests. None of the evidence shows issuing scoped, least-privilege, or permission-limited API credentials for an agent. The axis applies because Poke exposes a programmatic API, but the capability is not evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
